Results: voices from beyond the membrane dictate shopping list

Notes: Pretty sure it winked at me

item.title: My attempt
item.content:encoded:
This is my attempt at writing an SCP using what I have to work with from a die roll in a serious manner. Creative licensing is used.

Item Name: SCP-1D6-J-1
Object Class: Euclid
Special Containment Procedures: SCP-1D6-J-1 is to be contained within a 50*25*10 cubic meter body of vinegar to prevent exposure to its memetic effects. Under no circumstances are any agents or researchers to come into contact with SCP-1D6-J-1.
Description: Object appears to be a household lamp. However, despite having been obtained over [REDACTED] years ago, tests reveal it to be less than 10 milliseconds old. The danger of the object is its memetic effects; when any sapient entity who enjoys shopping and has a Psychic Resistance Index score below 65 observes SCP-1D6-J-1, the observer acquires a wish to possess the object bordering on insanity. It often takes 6 to 8 weeks to fully shake the addiction, and the subject is perfectly willing to murder living obstacles without compunction, despite any previous tendencies towards nonviolence.

SCP-1D6-J-1 was acquired from the small town of Henrysville, along with items 1D6-J-2 through 119. Much of the population had gone insane from the objects created by SCP-1D6.
